title: Finding report
description: One persona's authoring output (GATE-PRIMITIVE.md Stage 2; chorus-review Phase 1). Uncapped: no count target. In review mode the prose (claims, pull-quotes, reasons, gate questions) is at most 700 words; the question ledger is outside that limit. From schema 1.1 the ledger is required; a report declaring 1 or 1.0 predates it and stays valid without one.

schema_version.description: Schema version; the major must be 1. Write 1.1: from 1.1 the ledger is required.

mode.description: review: a chorus-review round (700-word limit). sdlc: a lifecycle gate. challenge: chorus challenge.

round.description: The round date or gate/cycle this report is for.

tool_uses.description: Tool calls made while authoring. Zero fails the Phase 1 evidence check.

gate_questions.description: Unmet [gate] needs, asked instead of inferred past (S10). Findings depending on one carry conditional_on.

id.description: Gate-question id (G1, G2, …), unique within the report. A ledger entry with outcome gate cites it.

need.description: The declared gate need, e.g. 'who the user is and how many'.

assumption.description: The assumption dependent findings are conditional on meanwhile.

findings.description: The findings, as many as the corpus honestly warrants. Ids are unique within the report.

ledger.description: The question ledger (GATE-PRIMITIVE.md Stage 2): each of the persona's signature questions SQ-1..SQ-n answered at both altitudes (the project as a whole, and the work under review), plus at most three round questions RQ-1..RQ-3 the persona wrote itself. Outside the word limit.

items.description: One question answered at one altitude.

sq.description: SQ-n: the persona's signature question n, numbered as in its persona file. RQ-n: a round question the persona wrote itself.

question.description: The round question's text, in the persona's words. Required for RQ-n; SQ-n text lives in the persona file.

altitude.description: project: the question asked of the project as a whole. work: asked of the piece of work under review.

outcome.description: finding: answered by findings (refs). clear: looked and found nothing (evidence says where). n/a: does not apply at this altitude (note says why). gate: blocked on a gate question (refs).

items.description: An Fn finding id or a Gn gate-question id in this report.

refs.description: The findings (outcome finding) or gate questions (outcome gate) this answer points to.

evidence.description: Where the persona looked. A clear needs at least one locator (the honest null).

note.description: At most 20 words. Required for n/a: why the question does not apply at this altitude.
